Adds the Turkish STF language and tidies up the Circuit tab.

## Downloads

- **Windows:** `STFIDE Setup 0.2.0.exe`
- **Linux:** the `.AppImage` (any distro) or the `.deb` (Debian/Ubuntu)

## What's new

- **STF dili:** sketches can be written in a Turkish-syntax language (`.stf` files) that STFIDE turns into Arduino C++ when you verify or upload. The editor has highlighting, autocomplete and live error marking for it, and you can see the generated C++ in its own tab.
- **Libraries in STF:** `kütüphane` and `nesne` give Turkish names to library objects such as the servo, LCD, DHT sensor and NeoPixel.
- **12 Turkish STF examples**, each with its circuit already drawn, plus `DAHİLİ_LED` for the on-board LED.
- **Communication settings only where they belong.** Serial, I2C and SPI are now set by clicking the board, above its pin list. A part shows only the bus it really uses (just the I2C LCDs show I2C), a wire shows the bus of the parts it connects, and passive parts such as resistors, LEDs and buttons show none.

## Known limitations

- **Uploading to a real board has not been tested yet**, and neither has running the installed AppImage. Please report any upload problems.
- The installers are not code-signed, so Windows SmartScreen may warn on first launch ("More info" → "Run anyway").
